# sendgrid_forward_spam_mail_settings (Resource)

Manages the account-wide spam forwarding mail setting, which forwards spam reports to a specified email address. This is a singleton: SendGrid has exactly one spam forwarding configuration per account (or per subuser, via the provider's `on_behalf_of`); creating this resource updates that configuration in place, and destroying it only removes it from Terraform state without resetting SendGrid's setting.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_forward_spam_mail_settings" "this" {
  enabled = true
  email   = "spam-reports@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the spam forwarding mail setting is enabled.

### Optional

- `email` (String) The email address that spam reports are forwarded to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `forward_spam_mail_settings`.
